name: Personal Paint
runtimeDependencies: Application-local Personal Blit, requester and image I/O libraries (included)
rexxsyslib.library and RexxMast for ARexx scripts
icon.library and newicon.library for the optional Personal Icon I/O module
datatypes.library and installed image datatypes for the optional DataTypes module
cybergraphics.library for optional CyberGraphX RTG support
notes: Cloanto's 7.1c distribution supplies the stock executable, four PPView 1.2 copies, local CPU and Agnus blitters, I/O modules, artwork, fonts, documentation and scripts. The executable embeds Cloanto_PPaint 7.1.

E. Plischke's separate Aminet pio_icon release supplies personal_icon_io.library 5.17. The stock tree's local blitters include 68000, 68020, 68030, 68040 and 68060 builds. Startup_1.set selects the Agnus and 68000 pair.
The preserved ClassicWB v28 OS39 bundle supplies the stock README, FAQ and six English, German and Italian help or registration files from H/7.

Checked BCWB sources preserve all stock icons and the customized Startup_1.set. The application-local paths and Programs/PPaint.info are owned here. System libraries, image datatypes and startup files keep their separate ownership.
